entities.summary: Marie Louise Lydia Elisabeth "Marlies" Veldhuijzen van Zanten-Hyllner is a former Dutch politician of the Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA). She was the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport in the first Rutte cabinet, serving from 14 October 2010 to 5 November 2012.
